'''R0-P6''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] that served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] aboard [[Carrick Station]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
R0-P6 appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' as the Republic's quest giver for the "[[Raid on Rakata Prime|Legacy of the Rakata]]" flashpoint.<ref name="TOR" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' {{1st}}
